# CreateAudioScene <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CreateAudioScene:Int32
```

**Returns:** The handle of the scene. It holds nothing until values are set in it.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Makes an empty audio scene: a set of bus volumes and listener settings that [ApplyAudioScene](ApplyAudioScene) sets all at once, with a fade. A game makes its scenes while loading and applies one when the place or the menu changes. See [Audio scenes](Audio-Scenes). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
world = CreateAudioBus()
space = CreateAudioScene()
AudioSceneListener space, BB_LISTENER_DOPPLER, 0
AudioSceneVolume space, world, 0.3
ApplyAudioScene space, 3000
```
